id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|a10: "...Oh, Luminary. All alone at this hour of midnight, what's the matter?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|706: "...Oh, Luminary. All alone at this hour of midnight, what's the matter?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|24d: I can't leave the village and abandon my companions!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|257: I can't leave the village and abandon my companions!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|263: "Please wait, {var:1}. The elder said he had something to tell you at the summit of Zwaardsrust.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|271: "He must have found a clue. Zwaardsrust's summit is reached from the entrance beside the cathedral. Let's go.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|288: "Even someone who was always just there can vanish in a moment. I should have known that...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|293: "If I saw her again, there were things I wanted to say and ask... So much, but I can't meet her anymore...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2a3: "...When I first met Serena, she was spacey and shaky. But she's changed so much since.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2ae: "If she were watching Serena, I'm sure she'd have praised her. I have a sister too, so I know...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2c0: "Sister left me so many things. I won't waver anymore.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2cb: "...I'll stay here a while longer in the night breeze. Please go rest at the inn.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2e0: "Oh... {var:1}. No wonder you can't sleep, but don't brood alone too much.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2ea: "I'd like to make everyone laugh and cheer them up, but I can't right now... Sylvando the entertainer still has far to go...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|2f7: "By the way, I hear a sorrowful tune from the inn. Is that Serena's harp...?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|307: "Hey, {var:1}. Earlier the terrace next to the inn was wrapped in a mysterious light.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|313: "Is dawn near...? But it was a mysterious light that felt even more nostalgic than sunrise.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|328: "It's as if the sky is crying... It reminds me of the last day I saw Eleonor.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|334: "Since that time sixteen years ago when I let you fall into the river, I've tried to grow strong enough to protect those I hold dear.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|343: "But I was still immature... Veronica, who tried to protect the world itself and every life, was far stronger...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|356: "...The rain seems to have stopped. The sky was crying earlier, but now the clouds have cleared completely.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|363: "Shouldn't you go back to the inn? Dawn will come soon, so sleep while you can.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|37d: "{var:1}... Please, don't you leave this world before me.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|386: "However ravaged by the Dark One, a world where only the young rush to death should never be.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|399: "...Hm? The sky cleared. A sad tune was playing earlier. Was that Serena's harp?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|3ad: "{var:1}... When Mordegon was born, all fates went awry.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|3b9: "If I had noticed Jasper's true nature sooner and stopped him, that child might not have died...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|45c: "By the way, you got Mordegon's blade when you defeated him, didn't you?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|467: "Its looks changed, but it was originally the Luminary's sword. Equipping it should be fine, no?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|47b: "New leaves sprout on Yggdrasil, and the next life is born... That is how our lives connect.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|48b: "Sister is gone... but someday I feel we'll meet again somewhere.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|495: "Born again someday under the same leaf. I promised that with Sister. Until then, I'll live with all my might!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|4aa: "Ooh, how wonderful! I never thought the day would come to dance with you serious people of Arboria like this!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|4b5: "With the Dark One who stole everyone's freedom gone, we're another step closer to my dream of making the world smile!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|4cd: "Since the day sixteen years ago I let you go, I've run with the creed to crush evil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|4db: "But that's over now. From here on, I think it's time to walk my own path.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|4e7: "First, rebuilding Heliodor. And I want to tour sweets shops in Gondolia... Anyway, I'll do everything I want!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|4fc: "Seeing the people so happy, the sense that we saved the world wells up in me.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|509: "When did I last feel so bright? Thinking back, our journey was so harsh that I can hardly believe this peace.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|519: "There's still much to do... but my dream of a leisurely retirement may not be far off. Ho ho ho.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|52c: "H-handsome? A fine physique?! I'm merely a general of Heliodor. I'm not worthy of such praise!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|53d: "H-hey, {var:1}! These ladies won't let me go! Do something!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|559: "...{var:1}. Are you really sure about this?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|55f: "As the Keeper of Time said, if you go back to the past, you can't return to this world. Even you don't know what will happen.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|56d: "Even so... even so, you say you'll go back to the past?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|57a: "Right? Then this talk is over. Let's get out of this place right away!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|58b: "Go on, {var:1}. If you've decided, we won't say another word.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|596: "Save the world once more with your own hands. I'm counting on you, {var:1}...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5a8: "I'm sorry, {var:1}. Even if it is your decision, this I cannot accept...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5b2: "I swore the day I cut my hair that I'd protect you for the sister who is gone.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5c0: "If anything happened to you, Sister would scold me. So please reconsider...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5d0: "...I understand your feelings, {var:1}. Your will is that firm.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5da: "If you've decided, I will follow your will. Please... pass through.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5eb: "{var:1}... we defeated the Dark One and saved the world. We've done more than enough.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|5f7: "I... I can't take it anymore. I can't lose another dear companion. I don't want you to be gone too.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|60a: "Honestly... Erik, saying such cool things! Thanks to him I realized something important.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|614: "My dream is to make everyone in the world smile. It wouldn't be fair not to cheer up everyone in the past too!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|622: "Now, {var:1}! Go back to the past and make every last one of them smile!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|633: "If I let you go now and something happens to you... I'd surely regret it again.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|63e: "So please... don't go. I don't want to lose you too.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|64c: "I was so focused on protecting you that perhaps I didn't believe in you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|658: "Now I believe in you with all my heart. To truly save the world, I entrust everything to you, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|66b: "Harsh fate always takes so much from me. But this time I must stop it.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|677: "{var:1}, just this once, indulge an old man's selfishness. If you were gone too, I...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|685: "Ho ho ho, {var:1}. Why such a sad face?
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|68c: "A man about to achieve something great shouldn't make that face. Just walk the path you believe in.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|6a0: "{var:1}... sorry, but I can't let you go to the past.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|6a7: "Damn it, why can't I go to the past?! Am I to sit idle here, unable to stop Mordegon's ambition with my own hands...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|6ba: "That I couldn't protect the Luminary {var:1}, or strike down Mordegon myself... I hate my own helplessness.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|6c6: "{var:1}, I'm sure you can save the world. I believe in you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|748: "Please wait. For today, let's rest at the inn the elder arranged.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|758: "Please wait, {var:1}. As the elder said, let's head to the cathedral now.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|768: Veronica, elder of the sage twins. She became a shield for all life and sleeps here.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|774: The Time orb floats above the altar.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|7d3: For now, it seems best to look into holy Arboria.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|7f1: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 5."
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|7f8: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. The collapsed young man I saved on my journey turned out to be the village chief's son.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|805: The chief prepared two gifts for me and the desert doctor who saved his son, and told us to choose.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|815: Unbelievably, one gift was a lovely rainbow-glowing branch. The rainbow branch I had sought for years!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|826: The other was a small blue glowing stone, said to open a travel gate somewhere in the world and lead to a new world.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|836: I meant to choose the rainbow branch at once, but my hand was stopped by the long adventure spent seeking it.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|847: ...And I realized: my heart is still unfulfilled, wishing to keep traveling forever...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|853: What is the greatest treasure for me? I quietly slipped the blue glowing stone into the pocket of my worn jacket.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|861: The old doctor who took the rainbow branch has no intention of selling it for gold and says he'll treasure it for life.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|871: So the journey for the rainbow branch ended, but I will keep traveling.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|87c: If you ever meet me, please call me by my real name. ...My name is Theo, treasure hunter.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|89c: It's a book called "The Legendary Architect."
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|8a1: The sage statue in holy Arboria was made long ago by an architect who traveled the world, over his lifetime...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|8af: Together with the Luminary statue it forms a pair, a married couple, which for some reason is little known.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|8ba: When setting out on a journey, do visit the Luminary statue said to be in Dundrasil. You will receive the two's blessing.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|8e7: It's a book called "The Origins of the Holy Land."
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|8eb: Long ago, when the evil god appeared in the world, a Luminary stood up and set out with companions to slay it.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|8fa: This village, holy Arboria, was built by people who gathered to support the Luminary's journey.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|906: And Arboria's ancestors resolved to preserve that legend forever, never forgetting their debt to the Luminary.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|915: Holy Arboria, village of divine tales. The name is purely an expression of gratitude and respect for the Luminary.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|92e: It's a very old book called "The Dreamseer Bloodline."
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|934: Since ancient times, a person with dream sight is said to be born in holy Arboria every few hundred years.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|940: Dream sight is a strange power to see in dreams, while asleep, things that will happen a little in the future.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|94d: Dream sight has guided and saved many over these centuries, but the nature of the power is not well understood.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|95b: Old scholars' books say one theory holds it was a power granted from the sky to Arboria's ancestors...
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|985: A diary lies here. The cover reads "Diary of Veronica, Genius Mage."
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|992: Today I practiced magic for the first time! The elder taught us a healing spell and a fire spell!
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|99c: But no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't use the healing spell, and Serena couldn't use the fire spell.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|9a6: Serena cried, saying she couldn't be a great sage like this, but I don't think that at all.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|9b0: Because if I get hurt, Serena will heal me with healing magic. And I'll protect Serena with fire magic.
id./param/region/r016.pack|book_ie.bxon|9ba: We're always together. Whatever one lacks, the other can fill. ...So it's all right, Serena.

tm.「……おや 勇者さま。\n こんな 真夜中に\n おひとりで どうされたんですか: "...Oh, Luminary. All alone at this hour of midnight, what's the matter?
tm.仲間を置いて 里を出ていくわけにはいかない！: I can't leave the village and abandon my companions!
tm.「お待ちください {var:1}さま。\n 長老さまが ゼーランダ山の山頂で\n: "Please wait, {var:1}. The elder said he had something to tell you at the summit of Zwaardsrust.
tm.「きっと 何か 手がかりを見つけたのですわ。\n ゼーランダ山の山頂へは 大聖堂: "He must have found a clue. Zwaardsrust's summit is reached from the entrance beside the cathedral. Let's go.
tm.「当たり前のように そばにいたヤツでも\n ふとしたスキに いなくなっちまう。\: "Even someone who was always just there can vanish in a moment. I should have known that...
tm.「もう一度 アイツに会ったら\n 話したかったことや 聞きたかったこと……。\n: "If I saw her again, there were things I wanted to say and ask... So much, but I can't meet her anymore...
tm.「……セーニャは はじめて会った時は\n ぼんやりしていて 危なっかしいヤツだっ: "...When I first met Serena, she was spacey and shaky. But she's changed so much since.
tm.「もし アイツが セーニャのことを見ていたら\n きっと ほめてやっただろうと思: "If she were watching Serena, I'm sure she'd have praised her. I have a sister too, so I know...
tm.「お姉さまは 私に\n いろんなものを 残してくれました。\n 私は もう 迷い: "Sister left me so many things. I won't waver anymore.
tm.「……私は もうしばらくの間\n ここで 夜風に当たっていますわ。\n どうぞ: "...I'll stay here a while longer in the night breeze. Please go rest at the inn.
tm.「あら……{var:1}ちゃん。\n 眠れないのも ムリはないけれど\n あまり: "Oh... {var:1}. No wonder you can't sleep, but don't brood alone too much.
tm.「みんなを笑わせて 元気づけてあげたいけど\n 今は ちょっと ダメみたい……。: "I'd like to make everyone laugh and cheer them up, but I can't right now... Sylvando the entertainer still has far to go...
tm.「ところで 宿屋のほうから\n 切ない音色が聞こえてくるけれど\n これは セー: "By the way, I hear a sorrowful tune from the inn. Is that Serena's harp...?
tm.「ねえ {var:1}ちゃん。\n さっき 宿屋のとなりのテラスの辺りが\n 不: "Hey, {var:1}. Earlier the terrace next to the inn was wrapped in a mysterious light.
tm.「もうすぐ 夜明けなのかしら……？\n でも 朝日よりも もっと\n なつかしい: "Is dawn near...? But it was a mysterious light that felt even more nostalgic than sunrise.
tm.「まるで 空が泣いているようね……。\n エレノアさまと 最後に お会いした\n: "It's as if the sky is crying... It reminds me of the last day I saw Eleonor.
tm.「１６年前 あなたを川へ落としてしまった\n あの時から……。私は ずっと\n: "Since that time sixteen years ago when I let you fall into the river, I've tried to grow strong enough to protect those I hold dear.
tm.「でも 私は まだまだ未熟だったのね……。\n 世界そのものを……すべての命を守: "But I was still immature... Veronica, who tried to protect the world itself and every life, was far stronger...
tm.「……いつの間にか 雨が止んだみたい。\n さっきまで 空が泣いているようだった: "...The rain seems to have stopped. The sky was crying earlier, but now the clouds have cleared completely.
tm.「そろそろ 宿に戻らなくて大丈夫？\n じきに 夜が明けてしまうから\n 眠れる: "Shouldn't you go back to the inn? Dawn will come soon, so sleep while you can.
tm.「{var:1}……。\n そなただけは どうか わしよりも先に\n この世を去: "{var:1}... Please, don't you leave this world before me.
tm.「いくら 魔王の手によって 荒廃したといっても\n 若い者ばかりが 死に急ぐ世の: "However ravaged by the Dark One, a world where only the young rush to death should never be.
tm.「……む？ 空が晴れたか。\n さっきまで 悲しげな曲が流れていたが\n あれは: "...Hm? The sky cleared. A sad tune was playing earlier. Was that Serena's harp?
tm.「{var:1}……。\n あの時……魔王ウルノーガが生まれた時に\n すべての: "{var:1}... When Mordegon was born, all fates went awry.
tm.「俺が もっと早く ホメロスの正体に気づいて\n 止めることができていたら\n: "If I had noticed Jasper's true nature sooner and stopped him, that child might not have died...
tm.「そういえば お前\n ウルノーガを倒したとき\n 魔王の剣を 手に入れてたよな: "By the way, you got Mordegon's blade when you defeated him, didn't you?
tm.「見た目は 変わっちまったが\n あれは もともと 勇者のつるぎだったんだ。\n: "Its looks changed, but it was originally the Luminary's sword. Equipping it should be fine, no?
tm.「命の大樹に 新たな葉が芽吹き\n また 次の命が生まれる……私たちの命は\n: "New leaves sprout on Yggdrasil, and the next life is born... That is how our lives connect.
tm.「もう お姉さまは いませんが……。\n いつの日か また どこかで\n 出会え: "Sister is gone... but someday I feel we'll meet again somewhere.
tm.「またいつか 同じ葉のもとに 生まれる……。\n そう お姉さまと約束しましたか: "Born again someday under the same leaf. I promised that with Sister. Until then, I'll live with all my might!
tm.「あ～ん なんて すばらしいの！\n マジメな ラムダの人たちと こうして\n: "Ooh, how wonderful! I never thought the day would come to dance with you serious people of Arboria like this!
tm.「みんなの自由を奪う 魔王も いなくなったし\n これで世界中の人々を 笑顔にす: "With the Dark One who stole everyone's freedom gone, we're another step closer to my dream of making the world smile!
tm.「１６年前 あなたを手放してしまった日から\n 私は 悪を砕くという信念を胸に\: "Since the day sixteen years ago I let you go, I've run with the creed to crush evil.
tm.「でも それも もう終わり。\n これからは 私も そろそろ\n 自分の道を歩も: "But that's over now. From here on, I think it's time to walk my own path.
tm.「まずは デルカダール王国の復興でしょ。\n ダーハルーネでスイーツ巡りもしたい: "First, rebuilding Heliodor. And I want to tour sweets shops in Gondolia... Anyway, I'll do everything I want!
tm.「こうやって 民が よろこぶ姿を見ていると\n 我らが 世界を救ったという実感が: "Seeing the people so happy, the sense that we saved the world wells up in me.
tm.「こんな晴れやかな気持ちは 何年ぶりかの。\n 思えば ずっと 過酷な旅をしてき: "When did I last feel so bright? Thinking back, our journey was so harsh that I can hardly believe this peace.
tm.「やるべきことは まだまだあるが……。\n 悠々自適な隠居生活をする夢も\n そ: "There's still much to do... but my dream of a leisurely retirement may not be far off. Ho ho ho.
tm.「お…男前？ い いい身体ですと！？\n わ 私は デルカダール王国の いち将軍: "H-handsome? A fine physique?! I'm merely a general of Heliodor. I'm not worthy of such praise!
tm.「お おい {var:1}！ 先ほどから\n この ご婦人がたが 解放してくれん: "H-hey, {var:1}! These ladies won't let me go! Do something!
tm.「……{var:1}。\n お前は 本当に それでいいのか？: "...{var:1}. Are you really sure about this?
tm.「時の番人が言ったように 過去に戻ったら\n もう この世界に 戻ってこられない: "As the Keeper of Time said, if you go back to the past, you can't return to this world. Even you don't know what will happen.
tm.「それでも……それでも お前は\n 過去に戻るって言うのかよ？: "Even so... even so, you say you'll go back to the past?
tm.「だろ？ だったら この話は終わりだ。\n さあ とっとと こんな場所から\n: "Right? Then this talk is over. Let's get out of this place right away!
tm.「さあ 行けよ {var:1}。\n お前が決めたって言うなら\n オレたちは: "Go on, {var:1}. If you've decided, we won't say another word.
tm.「お前の手で もう一度 世界を救うんだ。\n 頼んだぞ {var:1}……！: "Save the world once more with your own hands. I'm counting on you, {var:1}...!
tm.「{var:1}さま ごめんなさい。\n たとえ あなたの決断でも\n これだけ: "I'm sorry, {var:1}. Even if it is your decision, this I cannot accept...
tm.「いなくなった お姉さまの分まで\n 絶対に あなたを守ると……。\n 私は 髪: "I swore the day I cut my hair that I'd protect you for the sister who is gone.
tm.「{var:1}さまに 何かあったら\n お姉さまに 叱られてしまいますわ。\n: "If anything happened to you, Sister would scold me. So please reconsider...
tm.「……{var:1}さまの お気持ち\n とても よく わかりましたわ。\n そ: "...I understand your feelings, {var:1}. Your will is that firm.
tm.「{var:1}さまが 決めたのなら\n 私も その意思に したがいますわ。\n: "If you've decided, I will follow your will. Please... pass through.
tm.「{var:1}ちゃん……アタシたちは\n 魔王を倒して 世界を救った。\n も: "{var:1}... we defeated the Dark One and saved the world. We've done more than enough.
tm.「アタシ……もう イヤなの。\n これ以上 大切な仲間を失うのは……。\n アナ: "I... I can't take it anymore. I can't lose another dear companion. I don't want you to be gone too.
tm.「まったく……カミュちゃんたら\n カッコいいこと 言っちゃってさ！\n おかげ: "Honestly... Erik, saying such cool things! Thanks to him I realized something important.
tm.「アタシの夢は 世界中の人々を笑顔にすること。\n 過去の みんなも 元気にして: "My dream is to make everyone in the world smile. It wouldn't be fair not to cheer up everyone in the past too!
tm.「さあ {var:1}ちゃん！\n 過去に戻って ひとり残らず\n 笑顔にしてあ: "Now, {var:1}! Go back to the past and make every last one of them smile!
tm.「もし ここで行かせてしまって\n あなたの身に 何かあったら……\n 私は き: "If I let you go now and something happens to you... I'd surely regret it again.
tm.「だから お願い……行かないで。\n 私は あなたまで失いたくないわ。: "So please... don't go. I don't want to lose you too.
tm.「私 あなたを守ることばかり考えて\n もしかすると あなた自身のこと\n 信じ: "I was so focused on protecting you that perhaps I didn't believe in you.
tm.「今こそ あなたを 心から信じる。\n 真に 世界を救うために\n あなたに す: "Now I believe in you with all my heart. To truly save the world, I entrust everything to you, {var:1}!
tm.「過酷な運命は いつも……。\n わしから さまざまなモノを奪う。\n しかし: "Harsh fate always takes so much from me. But this time I must stop it.
tm.「{var:1}。この一度だけ\n 年寄りの ワガママを聞いてくれ。\n おぬし: "{var:1}, just this once, indulge an old man's selfishness. If you were gone too, I...
tm.「ほっほっほ {var:1}よ。\n なんて 悲しそうなカオを しておるのじゃ。: "Ho ho ho, {var:1}. Why such a sad face?
tm.「今から 大きなことを成しとげる男が\n そんなカオをするもんじゃない。\n お: "A man about to achieve something great shouldn't make that face. Just walk the path you believe in.
tm.「{var:1}……悪いが\n お前を 過去には行かせられない。: "{var:1}... sorry, but I can't let you go to the past.
tm.「くそっ なぜ 俺は過去に行けないんだ！\n この手で ウルノーガの野望を止めら: "Damn it, why can't I go to the past?! Am I to sit idle here, unable to stop Mordegon's ambition with my own hands...!
tm.「勇者 {var:1}を守りきれず\n この手で ウルノーガを討てぬこと……。\: "That I couldn't protect the Luminary {var:1}, or strike down Mordegon myself... I hate my own helplessness.
tm.「{var:1} お前ならば……\n 必ずや 世界を救うことができるだろう。\n: "{var:1}, I'm sure you can save the world. I believe in you.
tm.「お待ちください。今日のところは\n 長老さまが 用意してくださった宿で\n ひ: "Please wait. For today, let's rest at the inn the elder arranged.
tm.「お待ちください {var:1}さま。\n 今は 長老さまが おっしゃった通り\: "Please wait, {var:1}. As the elder said, let's head to the cathedral now.
tm.双賢の姉 ベロニカ\nすべての命の盾となり ここに眠る: Veronica, elder of the sage twins. She became a shield for all life and sleeps here.
tm.時のオーブが 祭壇の上に 浮いている。: The Time orb floats above the altar.
tm.今は 聖地ラムダの様子を\n探ったほうが よさそうだ。: For now, it seems best to look into holy Arboria.
tm.『とあるトレジャーハンターの伝言 第５章』\nという本だ。: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 5."
tm.私は ナナシのトレジャーハンター。\n旅の途中で助けた 行き倒れの若者は\nなん: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. The collapsed young man I saved on my journey turned out to be the village chief's son.
tm.長は 息子を助けた 私と砂漠の国の医師に\nお礼の品を ふたつ用意したので\n好: The chief prepared two gifts for me and the desert doctor who saved his son, and told us to choose.
tm.信じられないことに 長が用意してくれた品は\n虹色にかがやく 美しい １本の枝。: Unbelievably, one gift was a lovely rainbow-glowing branch. The rainbow branch I had sought for years!
tm.もうひとつの品は 青く光る 小さな石。\n世界のどこかにある 旅の扉を開き\n新: The other was a small blue glowing stone, said to open a travel gate somewhere in the world and lead to a new world.
tm.もちろん すぐに 虹色の枝を選ぼうとした。\nしかし 私の手を止めさせたのは\n: I meant to choose the rainbow branch at once, but my hand was stopped by the long adventure spent seeking it.
tm.……そして 気がついたのだ。\nまだまだ 満たされない 自分の心に。\nずっと: ...And I realized: my heart is still unfulfilled, wishing to keep traveling forever...
tm.自分にとって 最高の宝とは なんなのか……。\n私は 青くかがやく まほうの石を: What is the greatest treasure for me? I quietly slipped the blue glowing stone into the pocket of my worn jacket.
tm.虹色の枝を受け取った 老医師は\nこの枝を金に換える気は ないらしく\n生涯の宝: The old doctor who took the rainbow branch has no intention of selling it for gold and says he'll treasure it for life.
tm.こうして 虹色の枝を求める旅は 終わったが\n私は これからも 旅を続ける。: So the journey for the rainbow branch ended, but I will keep traveling.
tm.もしも あなたが 私と出会うことがあったら\nその時は 私の本当の名前を呼んでほ: If you ever meet me, please call me by my real name. ...My name is Theo, treasure hunter.
tm.『伝説の建築家』という本だ。: It's a book called "The Legendary Architect."
tm.聖地ラムダの 賢者の石像は\n昔 世界中を旅する 建築家が\n生涯をかけて 作っ: The sage statue in holy Arboria was made long ago by an architect who traveled the world, over his lifetime...
tm.勇者の像と ふたつで対になっている\nいわゆる 夫婦像だという話は\nなぜか あ: Together with the Luminary statue it forms a pair, a married couple, which for some reason is little known.
tm.旅に出る時は ユグノア地方にあるという\n勇者の像を ぜひ拝んでほしい。\nかの: When setting out on a journey, do visit the Luminary statue said to be in Dundrasil. You will receive the two's blessing.
tm.『聖地のはじまり』という本だ。: It's a book called "The Origins of the Holy Land."
tm.はるか昔……邪神が この世に現れた時\nひとりの勇者が 立ちあがり\n仲間と共に: Long ago, when the evil god appeared in the world, a Luminary stood up and set out with companions to slay it.
tm.ここ 聖地ラムダという里は\nその勇者たちの旅を 支えるために\n集まった人々が: This village, holy Arboria, was built by people who gathered to support the Luminary's journey.
tm.そして 聖地ラムダの先祖たちは\n勇者に世界を救ってもらった 恩を忘れぬため\n: And Arboria's ancestors resolved to preserve that legend forever, never forgetting their debt to the Luminary.
tm.神語りの里 聖地ラムダ……。\nその呼び名は ひとえに\n勇者への感謝と 敬意の: Holy Arboria, village of divine tales. The name is purely an expression of gratitude and respect for the Luminary.
tm.『夢見の血筋』という とても古い本だ。: It's a very old book called "The Dreamseer Bloodline."
tm.いにしえの時代より この 聖地ラムダには\n数百年に一度 夢見のチカラを\n持つ: Since ancient times, a person with dream sight is said to be born in holy Arboria every few hundred years.
tm.夢見とは 眠っている間に\nすこし未来に起こることを 夢に見るという\nなんとも: Dream sight is a strange power to see in dreams, while asleep, things that will happen a little in the future.
tm.夢見のチカラは この数百年の間\n多くの人間を導き 救ってきたが\nチカラの正体: Dream sight has guided and saved many over these centuries, but the nature of the power is not well understood.
tm.昔の学者が残した 書物によると\n一説には 大昔 聖地ラムダに住む者の先祖が\n: Old scholars' books say one theory holds it was a power granted from the sky to Arboria's ancestors...
tm.１冊の日記帳が 置かれている。\n表紙には 『天才まほう使い ベロニカの日記』\: A diary lies here. The cover reads "Diary of Veronica, Genius Mage."
tm.今日は はじめて まほうの練習をしたわ！\n長老さまが いやしのまほうと\nほの: Today I practiced magic for the first time! The elder taught us a healing spell and a fire spell!
tm.でもね どんなに がんばっても\nあたしは いやしのまほうが 使えなくて\nセー: But no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't use the healing spell, and Serena couldn't use the fire spell.
tm.セーニャは これじゃ 立派な賢者になれないって\nメソメソ 泣いていたけれど\n: Serena cried, saying she couldn't be a great sage like this, but I don't think that at all.
tm.だって あたしがケガをしても セーニャが\nいやしのまほうで 治してくれるもの。: Because if I get hurt, Serena will heal me with healing magic. And I'll protect Serena with fire magic.
tm.あたしたちは いつも ふたり一緒。\n足りないところは どっちかが 埋めればいい: We're always together. Whatever one lacks, the other can fill. ...So it's all right, Serena.
